name: CRN_MultiHazard_Kriging_MOEGO
description: A reduced, reproducible case study accompanying the manuscript "Proactive Rehabilitation Planning for Concrete Road Networks Considering Multiple Hazards and Multiple Assets: A Kriging-based Multi-Objective Efficient Global Optimization Approach." Includes the Kriging-based Multi-Objective Efficient Global Optimization (MO-EGO) framework (surrogate model, optimizer, cost-based rehabilitation budget, network-processing routines) and the underlying high-fidelity earthquake/flood damage modeling and SUMO traffic-simulation engine (hazard-model settings, fragility parameters), for a concrete road network case study in Arden-Arcade, Sacramento, California.
